question: Who is the author of the book Languages of Truth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Salman Rushdie.**__

• **Salman Rushdie British writer born in India.** Realistic characters, unforgettable humor, enthusiasm, and melodramatic prose to examine the style of historical and philosophical issues.

• Shame.
 
• The Satanic Verses.
 
• Haroun and the Sea of Stories.
 
• The Moor’s Last Sigh.
 
• The Ground Beneath Her Feet.
 
• Fury.
 
• Shalimar the Clown.
 
• The Enchantress of Florence.
 
• Luka and the Fire of Life.
 
• Two Years Eight Months and Twenty-Eight Nights.
 
• The Golden House.
 
• Quichotte.
